patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger simulated-annealing strategy representation, cached suffix evaluation, and post-target block-placement choices, while incorporating the important slide semantics from the inspiration implementation: a slide may pass over an unvisited target square, and only its landing square is prohibited during setup routing.

The implementation is compacted and optimized using row bitmasks for the 20x20 board, fixed-size BFS queues, parent-action reconstruction only when necessary, greedy initialization with short lookahead, and cached partial reevaluation during local search.
